biological.citation: Lattier et al. 2019? / Garcia-Alonso et al. 2019 - The functional landscape of the human phosphoproteome (PMID: 31819260)
biological.summary: Among the prioritized regulatory phosphosites that were experimentally validated, phosphosites in SMARCC2, a SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling subunit, were found to have a role in neuronal differentiation.

biological.citation: Nuclear RIPK1 promotes chromatin remodeling to mediate inflammatory response (PMID: 35661830)
biological.summary: Nuclear RIPK1 physically associates with the BAF complex. Activated RIPK1 phosphorylates SMARCC2 to promote chromatin remodeling and transcription of specific proinflammatory genes. This was linked to enhancer/promoter occupancy in ALS models and human samples.

biological.citation: Chromatin remodeler BAF maintains HBV cccDNA transcriptional competence and represents a therapeutic target (PMID: 41665011)
biological.summary: TurboID-dCas9 proximity labeling, ChIP-seq and DNA pull-down identified SMARCC2 bound to HBV cccDNA enhancer-promoter regions. There it sustains nucleosome-depleted regions and recruits RNA Pol II. BAF inhibition (FHT-2344) compacted cccDNA chromatin and reduced HBV RNA by 70% and serum DNA by 50%.
biological.significance: P<.05 (serum HBV DNA); P<.01 (intrahepatic HBV RNA)

biological.citation: SMARCC2 mediates the regulation of DKK1 by the transcription factor EGR1 through chromatin remodeling to reduce the proliferative capacity of glioblastoma (PMID: 36418306)
biological.summary: SMARCC2 expression is low in GBM compared with low-grade glioma. Knockout increased glioblastoma cell proliferation and overexpression decreased it, including in intracranial nude mouse xenografts. SMARCC2 closes chromatin at the DKK1 promoter (an EGR1 target), which dampens PI3K-AKT signaling. The SWIRM domain was more important than SANT for chromatin remodeling function.

biological.citation: SMARCC2 combined with c-Myc inhibits the migration and invasion of glioma cells via modulation of the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway (PMID: 34080022)
biological.summary: SMARCC2 mRNA and protein are higher in low-grade than high-grade glioma tissue, and higher expression is associated with better prognosis. Co-IP showed SMARCC2 binds c-Myc and downregulates it. SMARCC2 overexpression reduced migration and invasion and decreased N-cadherin, vimentin, SNAI1 and β-catenin, whereas knockdown increased migration.

biological.citation: SMARCC2 silencing suppresses oncogenic activation through modulation of chromatin accessibility in breast cancer (PMID: 38852505)
biological.summary: In breast cancer cells, SMARCC2 silencing suppressed tumorigenesis, mammosphere formation and xenograft growth, and reduced cancer stem cell features, indicating a pro-tumorigenic role. ATAC-seq, RNA-seq and ChIP showed it downregulates Ras-PI3K signaling by controlling chromatin accessibility at enhancers of genes such as PIK3CB.

biological.citation: HSP110 Regulates the Assembly of the SWI/SNF Complex (PMID: 40498025)
biological.summary: The nuclear interactome of HSP110 is enriched for SWI/SNF components. HSP110 directly interacts with the core subunit SMARCC2 and facilitates SWI/SNF assembly, with chromatin association increased after temozolomide or oxaliplatin treatment.

biological.citation: A novel SWI/SNF complex promotes triple-negative breast cancer progression (PMID: 40890601)
biological.summary: ARID1B forms a novel SWI/SNF complex with SMARCC2 and SMARCB1 that transcriptionally represses ZNF382 and promotes TNBC proliferation and migration. ZNF382 knockdown rescue experiments tested the effects of inhibiting ARID1B, SMARCC2 and SMARCB1.

biological.citation: Machol et al. 2019 - Expanding the Spectrum of BAF-Related Disorders: De Novo Variants in SMARCC2 Cause a Syndrome with Intellectual Disability and Developmental Delay (PMID: 30580808)
biological.summary: SMARCC2 (BAF170) is an invariable core BAF subunit important in embryogenesis and corticogenesis. De novo heterozygous variants cause a neurodevelopmental syndrome, with SANT/SWIRM domain variants giving more severe phenotypes. Fibroblast transcriptomics of affected individuals showed differential expression of H19, SCRG1, RELN and CACNB4.

biological.citation: Elucidating the clinical and molecular spectrum of SMARCC2-associated NDD in a cohort of 65 affected individuals (PMID: 37551667)
biological.summary: Co-immunoprecipitation, proximity-ligation assays and 3D modeling of missense variants showed decreased protein expression for N-terminal missense variants, similar to loss-of-gene-function variants. Non-truncating variants cluster in functional domains and are associated with more severe developmental delay than truncating variants.
